## What We Offer

- Rooftop dining with multicuisine food: North Indian, South Indian, coastal Indian, Indo-Chinese, Asian, Mediterranean, Continental (pizza, pasta, seafood); vegetarian and non-veg
- Handcrafted premium cocktails
- Shisha lounge menu and sheesha combos
- Live music, DJ nights, Bollywood nights, quiz nights, Housie nights & live performances
- Happy hours with sheesha combos, beer bucket offers & bites specials
- Private events: birthday dinners, anniversary dinners, corporate and team dinners, rooftop parties
- Sunset dining, late-night lounge atmosphere
